review_type: Independent focused source and test review; no production edits or additional broad tests.
checks: Only mo containing ASCII caret in mover enters new semantic hat branch; other mover operators retain prior logic, including older dom Unicode-hat fallback.
Source stretchy=false selects hat; absent/true selects widehat. Exact source bases and surrounding script scope are retained.
Full-base explicit font variants survive transparent source wrappers; unsupported partial styles/operator-only styling are surfaced as errors rather than silently dropped.
Ordinary under/over labels, limits, superscripts and subscripts retain existing branches.
Focused tests cover authentic saved wide/narrow/bold source MathML, compound and nested bases, neighboring scripts, ordinary movers/limits, unsupported cues and MathJax round-trip geometry/fonts.
rationale_no_rerun: Implementation agent is executing the focused suite; this independent review avoids duplicate browser execution.
